landing.helplineDesc: Get direct telephone assistance from district animal husbandry specialists.
landing.recordModalDesc: Rapid intake for field emergencies and walk-in observations.
landing.deptTitle: Department of Animal Husbandry, Government of Maharashtra
landing.heroAudience: For farmers, field workers, veterinarians and district officers
landing.heroHeading: Every animal, once recorded, is never lost track of.
landing.heroLead: One shared record follows each animal from a farmer's first report through a field visit to a veterinarian's decision — across every village in the network.
landing.heroImageCaption: A veterinary officer examines a reported case in Haveli block, Pune district.
landing.fourPeopleLead: A livestock owner's observation, a field worker's visit, a veterinarian's decision, and a district officer's view of the wider picture — all attached to the same animal.
landing.livestockRegisterHeading: Your livestock, kept in one register.
landing.livestockRegisterLead: Digital health profiles, ear-tag registration, vaccination history, and treatment follow-ups for every animal in the herd.
landing.districtSurveillanceLead: Live village microclimate vectors, reported case clusters, and verified veterinary diagnoses mapped in real time.
landing.workflowSectionHeading: From first symptom to veterinary resolution
landing.workflowSectionLead: A structured four-step clinical pathway ensuring no animal illness goes unaddressed.
landing.helplineModalSub: Livestock Health & Disease Surveillance Network, Department of Animal Husbandry
landing.helplineAvail: Available every day, including holidays. Calls are answered in Marathi, Hindi, and English.
landing.helplineStep1: Describe what you have observed — lameness, discharge, loss of appetite, or sudden death.
landing.helplineStep2: Share the village and the ear-tag number if the animal is registered.
landing.helplineStep3: A field worker is dispatched, and the case appears on the district's active list.
landing.helplineStep4: You'll get a call back once a veterinarian has reviewed the report.
landing.helplineUrgent: For a suspected outbreak — several animals affected at once — say so first; these calls are routed ahead of the queue.
landing.builtForFieldLead: Engineered for rural Maharashtra, where field agents work through low connectivity and harsh outdoor light.
landing.offlineReportingBody: Log inspections in remote sheds without network. Syncs automatically on reconnect.
landing.photoEvidenceBody: Attach clinical photos of lesions and mucosal membranes, compressed on-device.
landing.gpsLocationBody: Automatic farm coordinates support reliable disease-cluster detection.
landing.villageVisitsBody: Track daily rounds and follow-up checks with local veterinarians.
landing.fromObservationLead: District veterinarians work from field evidence and AI-assisted differentials — the decision, and the record, stay theirs.
landing.districtActivityTitle: What is happening across the district.
landing.betterCareLead: Join livestock owners, village Pashusakhis, and veterinary officers across Maharashtra building a healthier, disease-resilient livestock network.
landing.footerTitle: Maitri Livestock Health & Disease Surveillance Network
landing.footerSub: Government of Maharashtra · Animal Husbandry Department
landing.footerNotice: Official surveillance & clinical decision support platform for rural livestock welfare.
